# teltonika_rms_role_permissions (Data Source)

Permission catalogue — for a specific role when `role_id` is set, otherwise all permissions the token is entitled to (`/roles/permissions`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "teltonika_rms_role_permissions" "all" {}

output "permission_titles" {
  value = [for p in data.teltonika_rms_role_permissions.all.permissions : p.title]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `role_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `title` (String)
